user.title: AdaptiveCharge – Power Measurement
user.description: Choose how your household net power is measured. This tells the integration whether to use a single grid meter or separate consumption and production sensors.

data_description.net_power_mode: Select 'Single net power sensor' if your energy meter reports a single value (positive = import, negative = export). Select 'Separate consumption & production sensors' if you have two separate sensors for house load and solar generation.

net_power.title: Net Power Sensor
net_power.description: Select the sensor that measures net grid power.

data_description.net_power_sensor: This sensor must report positive values when importing from the grid and negative values when exporting (e.g. during solar surplus). W or kW are both supported.
data_description.net_power_invert: Enable this if your meter reports the sign the other way around (positive = export, negative = import). AdaptiveCharge will multiply the reading by -1.

consumption_production.title: Consumption & Production Sensors
consumption_production.description: Select the sensors for total house consumption and solar production.

data_description.consumption_sensor: Total household power draw in W or kW, always positive. This is what your house is currently consuming.
data_description.production_sensor: Solar panel output in W or kW, always positive. The integration computes net = consumption − production.

charger.title: Charger Sensors
charger.description: Configure the EV charger power sensor and grid voltage. The voltage is used to convert surplus watts into amps for the charge current setpoint.

data_description.ev_power_sensor: The power currently drawn by the EVSE/charger in W or kW. This is added back to the surplus calculation so the integration can determine how much extra solar is available.
data_description.voltage_sensor: Optional: a live sensor reporting mains voltage (V). Used for the surplus-to-amps conversion. If not provided or unavailable, the fallback value below is used instead.
data_description.voltage_fallback: Fixed voltage used when no sensor is configured or when the sensor is unavailable. Use 230 V for most of Europe or 120 V for North America.

vehicle.title: Vehicle Entities
vehicle.description: Select entities that report vehicle presence, cable connection, and current battery range.

data_description.presence_entity: A device_tracker entity. When the state is 'home', charging can start. Used to avoid attempting to charge when the car is away.
data_description.cable_sensor: A binary_sensor that is ON when the charge cable is plugged into the vehicle. The integration uses cable plug-in events to trigger automatic charging decisions.
data_description.current_range_sensor: A sensor reporting the vehicle's current battery range in km. Used by the Charge Tonight feature to check whether the target range has been reached.

night_charging.title: Night Charging
night_charging.description: Configure the overnight charging schedule. Set your target range and the time window during which night charging is allowed.

data_description.desired_range: The battery range target in km for the Charge Tonight feature. Night charging runs until this range is reached or the window ends.
data_description.charge_window_start: The time at which the night charging window opens (hh:mm). Charge Tonight can activate from this time onwards.
data_description.charge_window_end: The time at which the night charging window closes (hh:mm). The Charge Tonight switch is automatically turned off at this time.

solar_optional.title: Solar Sensor (Optional)
solar_optional.description: Optionally provide a sensor for total solar production.

data_description.solar_sensor: Optional: a sensor reporting total solar yield in W or kW. Used to detect the 'Solar Done' state — when production drops below a threshold for a sustained period, indicating the sun has set. If not provided, Solar Done detection is disabled.

actuators_optional.title: Actuators
actuators_optional.description: Configure the entities that AdaptiveCharge uses to control your charger, and optionally link the vehicle's charge limit entity.

data_description.charge_switch: Optional: a switch entity used to enable or disable the EVSE relay. AdaptiveCharge turns this on/off when starting or stopping a charging session. If not provided, no relay commands are issued.
data_description.charge_current_number: Optional: a number entity used to set the charge current in amps. AdaptiveCharge writes to this entity to modulate the current based on available solar surplus. If not provided, current modulation is disabled.
data_description.charge_limit_number: Optional: a number entity that represents the vehicle's charge limit in %. Link this to your car's charge limit entity (e.g. 80 for 80%) so AdaptiveCharge can read or set how full the battery should charge. If not provided, charge limit management is disabled.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Fine-tune the control algorithm timing. The defaults work well for most installations.

data_description.smoothing_window: The rolling time window (seconds) over which available current samples are averaged. A longer window reduces oscillation from short cloud shadows. Default: 120 s.
data_description.sample_interval: How often (seconds) the integration reads sensor values and runs the control logic. Lower values react faster but use more resources. Default: 10 s.
data_description.solar_done_threshold: Solar production (W) below which the Solar Done countdown starts. Once production stays below this for the configured duration, Solar Done is triggered. Default: 50 W.
data_description.solar_done_duration: How long (seconds) production must stay below the threshold before Solar Done is triggered. Prevents false triggers from brief clouds. Default: 600 s.
data_description.start_delay: Debounce delay (seconds) before starting a new charging session. Prevents rapid on/off cycling when surplus fluctuates around zero. Default: 30 s.
data_description.stop_delay: Debounce delay (seconds) before stopping a charging session. Prevents premature stops caused by brief dips in solar surplus. Default: 30 s.
data_description.modulate_min_interval: Minimum time (seconds) between two consecutive current modulation commands. Prevents the charger from being flooded with adjustments. Default: 30 s.
